meta.title: Flagged for Review — items that could NOT be confirmed from an official verified source
meta.policy: Per project rules, any value that cannot be confirmed from an official source is left BLANK in the data tables and listed here with the reason. Nothing is inferred or filled in. These items do not block publication; they are published on the ‘Flagged for Review’ page for manual review.

rows.item: Numeric Pearson correlation coefficients between specific bet legs / prop pairs (e.g., QB passing yards vs team moneyline)
rows.reason: No official source publishes pairwise correlation values for betting markets; sportsbooks keep SGP/correlation pricing models proprietary. Values will be computed from our own logged bet data via the NIST formula before any combo strategy goes live (gate G7).

rows.item: Numeric home-field-advantage point value used in our own spread model (commonly cited as ~2.5–3 points in non-official commentary)
rows.reason: No NFL/official source publishes a single HFA constant; the value must be estimated from our own historical data and validated through gates G2–G5 before use. Not filled in.

rows.item: Historical backtest performance (win rate, ROI, CLV) of strategies ST-01…ST-09
rows.reason: No performance numbers are published because none have been computed yet from official data through the validation gates; any number here would be a hallucination. Cells intentionally blank.

rows.item: Exact vig/overround percentage for each specific market at each specific sportsbook
rows.reason: Prices move continuously and books do not publish their margin per market (Pinnacle: ‘few, if any, bookmakers publicly share it’). Only the standard -110 = 52.38% implied per side (11-to-10) is verified; per-market vig must be computed at bet time from posted odds via the official implied-probability formulas.

rows.item: ‘Sharpest book’ / specific CLV benchmark percentages quoted by non-official blogs (e.g., ‘+2% CLV is excellent’)
rows.reason: Such thresholds appear only on third-party sites, not on official sources; our leaderboard uses mean CLV > 0 plus statistical testing rather than a magic number.

rows.item: Live odds/lines, current standings, current injury report values as permanent data
rows.reason: These are dynamic official pages (verified live on 2026-11-01); snapshots are recorded with as-of timestamps in league_facts.json, but the live pages remain the source of truth. Values are re-pulled, never hard-coded.

rows.item: Which U.S. states currently license online sportsbooks / where each user may legally bet
rows.reason: Licensing varies by state and changes; Nevada Regulation 22 is cited as the regulatory model for grading/house rules, but a 50-state legality list is not maintained here — users must check their own state regulator. Not filled in to avoid stale/incorrect claims.

rows.item: NFL Next Gen Stats raw tracking data access for the public
rows.reason: NFL publishes aggregated NGS metrics/charts publicly; raw per-play tracking is released only to clubs and via Big Data Bowl competitions (per NFL Football Operations). Raw-data API access terms are not published on an official public page — flagged rather than assumed.

That legacy path returned 404 on 2026-11-01; the current official NGS technology page is /gameday/technology/nfl-next-gen-stats, which is the URL cited in sources.json. Noted here as a reviewed irregularity (dead official link), not used as a source.

rows.item: National Problem Gambling Helpline phone number presentation
rows.reason: NCPG's official page (checked 2026-11-01) presents the helpline as 1-800-MY-RESET, while other official state pages (e.g., mn.gov) still list 1-800-GAMBLER (1-800-426-2537). Both route to the same NCPG helpline; we cite the NCPG page as primary and note the legacy number rather than guessing which display is current.
